question: Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how many of them are taken place after 2012/1/1?
evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE'
clarification: Do not include the value '2012' itself.
gold: SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.Country = 'CZE' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) > '2012'
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.TransactionID) FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID WHERE T2.Country = 'CZE' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Date) >= '2012'

b.request: Count the transactions made at gas stations whose Country is 'CZE' with a transaction Date strictly after 2012-01-01, so transactions on 2012-01-01 itself are excluded
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k AS t JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Date > '2012-01-01'

c.request:
Among the transactions made in the gas stations in the Czech Republic, how many of them are taken place after 2012/1/1?
Evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE'
Do not include the value '2012' itself.
c.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k AS t INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Date > '2012-01-01'

d.request: Among the transactions made at gas stations in the Czech Republic (where the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE'), how many took place after 2012/1/1, excluding transactions from the year 2012 itself?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k AS t INNER JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' AND t.Date > '2012-12-31'
